description: Flutter starter template of the Flutter Bond framework (v2.1.0, Flutter 3.47.7): feature modules with service providers, Riverpod 3, go_router, BondFire networking, staging/production flavors, Firebase setup, English/Arabic localization, iOS and Android projects.
rules: Create projects from the template with bond_cli: dart install bond_cli, then bond create project --projectName my_app --bundleId com.example.app (clones tag v2.1.0).
Every run or build needs --flavor (staging/production on Android, Staging/Production on iOS) and --dart-define-from-file=env.json or env.staging.json; API timeouts in the env files are milliseconds.

Features live in lib/features/<feature>/ with data/ (api.dart, models/), presentation/, <feature>_service_provider.dart and routes.dart; register the provider in lib/app/app.dart and spread the routes in lib/app/routes.dart.
iOS uses Swift Package Manager only (no CocoaPods); the app is universal (iPhone and iPad).
Upgrading a v1 app: follow MIGRATION.md.
